tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Opens an interactive inline Drag & Drop EU upload widget directly inside supporting chat clients (MCP Apps) AND returns a temporary zero-retention EU upload URL (upload_url) so a user can upload a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, or image directly to Aigine in the EU.

tools.name: propose_masking
tools.description: Identify and mask personal data (GDPR direct, indirect, and sensitive Art. 9) and confidential information (OSL / trade secrets) in documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, images) in the EU using specialized descriptive encoder AI (98%+ accuracy, flattened irreversible PDF, strict zero retention). RULES: (1) AU

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: propose_masking · Private data: propose_masking, fetch_reviewed_document · Public sink: create_upload_link, propose_masking · Destructive: create_upload_link, fetch_reviewed_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: propose_masking · Private data: propose_masking, fetch_reviewed_document · Public sink: create_upload_link, propose_masking · Destructive: create_upload_link, fetch_reviewed_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
